mission: Owner decision 2026-11-14 (content-pipeline chat, 'go gate'): PRs that touch auth, security or build supply chain paths are always DATA lane. The policy gate stops accepting an 'Independent security review:' line in the PR description as a way into PRODUCT, because the PR's author writes that line and it can't prove a review happened. These paths stay DATA until an approval the PR author can't create exists (SEC-001). This only tightens the gate: nothing that is DATA today becomes PRODUCT. Delivery-scope classification of merged diffs (require_security_review=False) is unchanged. Opened by Claude, not the CP engineer, because it is the gate on the engineer's own PRs; labelled hold-for-owner, the owner merges.

impacts.reason: policy-gate classifier: any changed file matching SECURITY now adds a DATA reason whatever the PR body says; SECURITY_REVIEW regex removed. SECURITY path list, other lane rules, outputs (security_paths, security_review_required) and fail-closed behaviour unchanged.

Old tests that let a review line reach PRODUCT replaced: auth and supply chain paths stay DATA for an empty body, PENDING, TBD, '-', a blank line followed by text, and a real-looking review line with SHA and URL. New test pins delivery-scope classification (require_security_review=False) as unchanged.
The four places that described the review-line rule now say these paths are always DATA until SEC-001. Wording only; no workflow, permission or trigger change.

resources: policy-gate lane classification for PRs to staging
routes: None: CI tooling and docs only; no API, web or collector route
dependencies: staging 851741f5 or later; no open PR must merge first
impact.deployment_impact: No service, collector, fleet or schema change. Only future PRs touching auth, security or supply chain paths are classified DATA and need a mission file.

recovery.procedure: Native revert PR with its own mission file restores the review-line rule.
recovery.trigger: The owner reverses the decision, or the gate misclassifies a non-security PR as DATA.
recovery.backup: Not applicable: no schema or row change.

verification.observation_window: The next PR touching an auth or supply chain path: policy-gate shows lane data with the SEC-001 reason.
